title: Gold Wing Tour DCT (Pro Spec)
description: Representing Honda's engineering ethos in the Luxury Grand Tourer class, the Honda Gold Wing Tour DCT (Pro Spec) is built for luxurious two-up cross-country expeditions with supreme wind protection. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
